verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar's own docs state it offers one-click DNSSEC activation, free to all customers, which covers the 'supported and easy' core of the story. The evidence never explicitly says the DS records are submitted to the registry automatically, and no API-driven DNSSEC signing is documented. The Registrar API is described only as domain search, registration and management. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that DS records are published at the registry, API-driven DNSSEC enablement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, DNSSEC is supported and easy — one-click or API-driven signing with the DS records handled at the registry

citations.quote: Cloudflare Registrar offers one-click DNSSEC activation. DNSSEC secures DNS records with cryptographic signatures, and is free to all Cloudflare customers.
Cloudflare Registrar offers one-click DNSSEC activation for free to all customers
